name: almanca_konus
description: Front-end libraries for Almanca Konuş. Not needed to build or run the site: wwwroot/lib already contains the files. Use this only to refresh a vendored library (npm install, then npm run copy:libs) or to compile custom.scss (npm run build:css).

scripts.copy:libs: copyfiles -u 2 "node_modules/bootstrap/dist/**/*" wwwroot/lib/bootstrap && copyfiles -u 2 "node_modules/three/build/**/*" "node_modules/three/examples/jsm/**/*" wwwroot/lib/three && copyfiles -u 4 "node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/*.min.css" wwwroot/lib/fontawesome/css && copyfiles -u 4 "node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/*" wwwroot/lib/fontawesome/webfonts && echo "Font Awesome changed: run python .github/tools/frontend/fa_subset.py"
